text.description_html:
Acorn KP5JP, Hand Forged Stainless Steel Egg Cabinet Knob

An easy way to change any tired kitchen decor is to update the cabinet hardware. Just imagine how people will swoon over these hand-forged egg cabinet knobs by Acorn. Each one is crafted traditionally with a hammer and anvil, the marks of its handmade origins granting the cabinet knob's unique character. Each is a little different, a little work of art. The forging process darkens the Hand Forged Stainless Steel Egg Cabinet Door Knob in an uneven pattern, providing a natural finish (similar to antique nickel or pewter). It is this natural stainless steel finish that is perfect for not only modern decors but also more traditional styles, able to accent this contemporary material with a natural feel that just seems to belong in any setting.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Hand Forged Stainless Steel Egg Cabinet Door Knob:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Height: 1-1/4"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
